sources.read: full documentation and provider, viewport, root and store source

implementation: Explicit immutable TanStack notification store; no global queue allocation
Owned monotonic timers preserve remaining time and independent pause reasons
Native top-layer viewport, limited newest stack, measured geometry and shared Lit Motion springs
Alert/Button composition, serializable application-owned actions, cancelable requests
Author nodes remain owned by their framework; descriptions remain safe text
Shared announcement ownership prevents duplicate announcements on viewport handoff
adaptations: Horizontal outward swipe preserves vertical scrolling; 40px dismissal and 10px reversal thresholds follow the reviewed source.
Applications own keyboard shortcuts and can call viewport.focus(); no implicit global F6 handler.
Alert status treatments compose the message surfaces instead of maintaining a second message renderer.
corrections: Closing geometry remains available until its exit animation settles
Disconnected pending updates cannot reattach timer presentations
Visible-limit arrivals transfer focus before hiding the focused record
Updated announcements replace previous content and hidden records leave the announcer
Generated identities skip explicitly reserved IDs
removed: Standalone AcmeError/acme-error; Alert and Field own message contexts
All retired style mappings, splitter producers and raw CSS rules
Legacy Toast methods and callback/HTML records
